# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Device Guard and Credential Guard

Turns on virtualisation-based security, Credential Guard and memory integrity, so that credentials are held in an isolated part of memory. Requires a restart and can block old drivers.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | — |
| Source | OpenIntuneBaseline Windows v4.0 — SC - Device Security - U - Device Guard, Credential Guard and HVCI |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Device_Guard_and_Credential_Guard.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Device_Guard_and_Credential_Guard.json) |

> OIB assigns this to users to avoid a restart in the middle of Autopilot; all 8 settings are device-scoped, hence D here. Keep in mind that the first application requires a restart.
